scripts.// Note: Combined predev into concurrently to prevent one script failure from blocking others
scripts.// Logic: sketchpad.bat runs the manifest check once (node ./node/maintain_manifests.mjs) and then launches the environment; the app asks the service for a complete rebuild after any manifest change
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n SVC,VITE "npm run dev:svc" "npm run dev:vite"
scripts.dev:sketchpad: npm run predev && npm run dev:all
scripts.start:sketchpad: concurrently -n MAINT,DEV,OPEN "npm run predev" "npm run dev:all" "npm run open:sketchpad"
scripts.start:draw: concurrently -n VITE,OPEN "npm run dev:draw" "npm run open:draw"
scripts.lint:globals: eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern ui draw classes drawRegistry utilities home gallery patterns help main.js drawMain.js
